description: This file defines a PHP class PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams used to encapsulate search filter parameters for reports in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the PIM plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and manages filter attributes such as name and report ID, with predefined allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing search filter parameters for Pim-defined reports, including properties for report name and report ID, with methods to get and set these properties. It also initializes a default sort field upon instantiation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'report.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter criterion.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the 'name' filter criterion to the given string or null.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the current report ID filter value.

methods.name: setReportId
methods.description: Sets the report ID filter value to the provided integer or null.
